item: row 320: the damaged-store test helper builds its stores through the app's pragmas (WAL)
summary: The conversion reverted in af34ce675 (it exposed the R781 repair bug, fixed by #2273) is back: build_app_store uses tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so the stores the repair, salvage, verify and damage tests work on are WAL files like the app's own library, on both engine legs. The bare-engine ratchet goes from 37 to 36. No helper reads or hashes a store file while a connection of its own is open (R789).
